content: Control port shall not become a part of the PortGroup Please note that the control port shall not become a part of the PortGroup that defines the particular VFC the control port is going to service. The relationship is implemented by means of a specific SwcServiceDependency that owns a RoleBasedPortAssignment to the intended control port and refers to a PortGroup (that comprises the VFC) in the role representedPortGroup .
